comparisonProtocol.baselineScope: Full untouched checkout at the baseline commit, including its original city plan/materials. New connector views can be set manually to these same coordinates in the old renderer.
comparisonProtocol.stillConditions: Same camera position, target, 48 degree vertical FOV, paused physical state, 1600x900 drawing buffer, pixel ratio 1, quality and weather. Lock exposure to the matching baseline preset (day .90, night 1.08) for a material/geometry comparison; capture revised automatic exposure separately.
comparisonProtocol.timingConditions: Record browser, GPU, resolution and quality; separate loading/5 s prewarm from 150 s driven steady capture. Actual route inputs/trajectory accompany p50/p95/p99 and long frames.
comparisonProtocol.acceptance: Requires actual WebGL images and measured display/GPU timing. Scene graph, shader and DOM checks are separate structural evidence.

geometry.model: v7 / 3.9: continuous wedge shoulder, concave lower door, satin silver clearcoat, smoked glass, sculpted five-sector wheels; independent official-photo reconstruction, not OEM CAD

userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/154.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
limits: Real local framebuffer capture. No automatic image-quality or FPS verdict; dimensions are engineering assumptions. 3.8 baseline retains its own original glass/body materials under the current light rig.
